title: Wordle
event_title: Wordle starts spreading on social media
lede: A free daily word game that spread through shared grids, followed from the games people looked up to what they borrowed.
description: A time-ordered ripple map for Wordle: each step dated and marked by how it was measured.
limits: Wikipedia stands in for all attention and one city's library for borrowing. Timing shows order, not proof that the event caused each step on its own.
dataline: Wikimedia pageviews (daily), Seattle Public Library checkouts (monthly)

steps.title: People look up the games behind it
